ADDED · Use the selected CDL independent elapsed stopwatch for the advisory warning.
ADDED · Source-measured elapsed continues after gripper release; warning resolution includes the existing roughly 500 ms message cadence.
ADDED · Only a fresh, bounded CDL stopwatch sample feeds the warning.
ADDED · Publish only the current handled-part warning context to CDL.
ADDED · Publish only the current handled-part warning context to CDL.
ADDED · CDL slot display is one-based.
ADDED · Strictly exceeding the calculated maximum requests the CDL popup; it never issues a wash command.
ADDED · Target only the selected CDL.
ADDED · Wrap the display sample marker.
ADDED · Atomic publication into the existing CDL-initiated read; no new FDC-to-CDL MSG.
ADDED · The existing PA209 read receives the same display contract with the selected target ID.
SOURCE · original PLC storage / Item InOut
Blue = original. Red = fault + nonzero code; fault 0 = neutral. Yellow = state + value. GUTTER = group / qualifier; INIT is a label only.
